treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Singapore and the Hellenic Republic for the elimination of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2019)
eif_quote: Date of Conclusion: 30 May 2019 Entry into Force: 14 March 2022 Effective Date: 1 January 2023. Art. 29(1)(a)(i): in the Hellenic Republic in respect of taxes withheld at source, for amounts paid or credited on or after 1st January of the calendar year next following the date on which this Convention enters into force
source_title: IRAS text: Singapore-Greece DTA (ratified)(14 Mar 2022), incl. Protocol 2019

rates.quote: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 7.5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 7.5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Treaty not covered by the MLI; PPT is built into the 2019 Convention (Art. 25), effective with the Convention (WHT from 1 Jan 2023). Not modelled: interest beneficially owned by a bank taxable only in residence State (Art. 11(3)); interest paid to the Government (incl. local authorities, central bank, GIC) exempt (Art. 11(4)). No holding-period requirement for the 5% dividend tier.
